name: Self-Esteem
description: Pattern related to self-doubt, harsh inner critique, or low self-worth.
safetyGuidance: This is not a clinical diagnosis. Informational pattern match based on self-evaluation statements.

solutions.title: Self-Compassion Exercise
solutions.purpose: Guide the user through a short self-compassion activity.
instructions: Place your hand gently over your heart.
Acknowledge: 'This is a moment of struggle, and struggle is part of being human.'
Offer yourself the same words of encouragement you would give a beloved friend.
Breathe warmly as you hold yourself with kindness.

solutions.title: Positive Self-Reflection
solutions.purpose: Help the user identify positive qualities or experiences.
instructions: Recall one obstacle or difficulty you have handled in the past.
Notice the strength, patience, or effort you showed.
Write down or mentally hold 3 qualities you value about yourself.

solutions.title: Strengths Checklist
solutions.purpose: Allow the user to record strengths and positive qualities.

solutions.title: Guided Meditation
solutions.purpose: Provide a short mindfulness practice for self-acceptance.
instructions: Observe harsh inner critical voices without accepting them as facts.
Return focus gently to the calm rhythm of your breath.

solutions.title: Small-Achievement Activity
solutions.purpose: Choose and complete one small achievable task.
